text:
mike: FYI repro: streaming upload fails intermittently on Pixel 8 emulator (Android 14) when our SDK follows redirects automatically. Seen with OkHttp 5.0.0-alpha and Retrofit 3.

sara: hmm, what does "fails" look like? 500s? connection closed?

mike: server does 307 -> 302 redirect sequence for file ingest. okhttp follows redirect but drops Authorization header on the second hop. streaming body then gets reset and we see: HTTP/1.1 401 and chunked stream aborted.

ben: that sounds like the classic header drop on followRedirects. okhttp will remove auth header unless you implement an authenticator that reattaches it.

alice: can you paste the client config?

mike: here's minimal repro in sampleapp: 

```
val client = OkHttpClient.Builder()
  .followRedirects(true)
  .followSslRedirects(true)
  .callTimeout(2, TimeUnit.MINUTES)
  .build()

val service = Retrofit.Builder()
  .baseUrl("https://upload.example.com/")
  .client(client)
  .build()
```

And we do a streaming request body that reads a FileInputStream. First redirect works, second redirect target is on a different host and okhttp clears sensitive headers.

ben: try adding an Authenticator instead of relying on header-only auth. Authenticator.getCredential will be called on redirects too and you can re-add header. Alternatively, handle redirects manually (followRedirects(false)) and forward headers explicitly.

sara: also watch out for setCookieJar behavior. On emulator the cookie jar seemed to miss the second domain so server responded unauthenticated. Could be two independent issues.

alice: did you reproduce on real device or only emulator?

mike: reproduced on emulator and on-device in lab (Pixel 7). More frequent on emulator though.

devex-bot: FYI — created ticket DEVEX-4921 to track: "redirect chain drops auth/cookies causing streaming upload failures on Android" :spiral_note_pad:

mike: small workaround we tested: disable automatic redirects for that endpoint and perform a manual 307->follow with a new Request.Builder().headers(original.headers). Also we had to rewind the streaming body; FileInputStream doesn't support rewind so we buffer small files into byte[] on retry. Not great for large uploads.

ben: another option: use chunked transfer but ensure the server issues single redirect to final host (server-side fix). If not possible, consider adding a short-lived signed URL flow so client can post directly to final host without auth header.

alice: for SDK parity note — our Java/Kotlin sampleapp currently demonstrates basic header-based auth only. We should add an example Authenticator implementation and a section on redirect semantics in the Android guide.

mike: agreed — I'll open a PR with an authenticator snippet + small sample that uses followRedirects(false) + manual redirect flow. Keeping it tiny so onboarding stays low friction.

ben: also add a test matrix note: okhttp 4.x vs 5.x behavioral differences around default header retention on cross-host redirects. That bit surprised me.

mike: good call. adding to PR checklist. Thanks all :thumbsup:

sara: tagging @alice for docs changes once PR lands.

alice: got it. will add a short section in devex/samples and link from onboarding checklist.

mike: closing loop — workaround removed after server fix rolled out in prod. Will add a follow-up postmortem if anyone wants details.

ben: ping me if you need a unit test harness for streaming rewinds.

mike: will do. cheers! :partyparrot:
